// DRILL-3257 (Simplified Query from TPC-DS query 74)
@Test
public void testUnionAllInWith() throws Exception {
    final String query1 = "WITH year_total 
" + "     AS (SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id,
" + "                1 year_total
" + "         FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c
" + "         UNION ALL 
" + "         SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id, 
" + "                1 year_total
" + "         FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c) 
" + "SELECT count(t_s_secyear.customer_id) as ct 
" + "FROM   year_total t_s_firstyear, 
" + "       year_total t_s_secyear, 
" + "       year_total t_w_firstyear, 
" + "       year_total t_w_secyear 
" + "WHERE  t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id 
" + "       AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id 
" + "       AND t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id 
" + "       AND CASE 
" + "             WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_w_secyear.year_total 
" + "             ELSE NULL 
" + "           END > -1";
    final String query2 = "WITH year_total 
" + "     AS (SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id,
" + "                1 year_total
" + "         FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c
" + "         UNION ALL 
" + "         SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id, 
" + "                1 year_total
" + "         FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c) 
" + "SELECT count(t_w_firstyear.customer_id) as ct 
" + "FROM   year_total t_w_firstyear, 
" + "       year_total t_w_secyear 
" + "WHERE  t_w_firstyear.year_total = t_w_secyear.year_total 
" + " AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 and t_w_secyear.year_total > 0";
    final String query3 = "WITH year_total_1
" + "             AS (SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id,
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c
" + "                 UNION ALL 
" + "                 SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id, 
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c) 
" + "             , year_total_2
" + "             AS (SELECT c.n_nationkey    customer_id,
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/nation.parquet` c
" + "                 UNION ALL 
" + "                 SELECT c.n_nationkey    customer_id, 
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/nation.parquet` c) 
" + "        SELECT count(t_w_firstyear.customer_id) as ct
" + "        FROM   year_total_1 t_w_firstyear,
" + "               year_total_2 t_w_secyear
" + "        WHERE  t_w_firstyear.year_total = t_w_secyear.year_total
" + "           AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 and t_w_secyear.year_total > 0";
    final String query4 = "WITH year_total_1
" + "             AS (SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id,
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c
" + "                 UNION ALL 
" + "                 SELECT c.n_nationkey    customer_id, 
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/nation.parquet` c), 
" + "             year_total_2
" + "             AS (SELECT c.r_regionkey    customer_id,
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/region.parquet` c
" + "                 UNION ALL 
" + "                 SELECT c.n_nationkey    customer_id, 
" + "                        1 year_total
" + "                 FROM   cp.`tpch/nation.parquet` c) 
" + "        SELECT count(t_w_firstyear.customer_id) as ct 
" + "        FROM   year_total_1 t_w_firstyear,
" + "               year_total_2 t_w_secyear
" + "        WHERE  t_w_firstyear.year_total = t_w_secyear.year_total
" + "         AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 and t_w_secyear.year_total > 0";
    testBuilder().sqlQuery(query1).ordered().baselineColumns("ct").baselineValues((long) 80).build().run();
    testBuilder().sqlQuery(query2).ordered().baselineColumns("ct").baselineValues((long) 100).build().run();
    testBuilder().sqlQuery(query3).ordered().baselineColumns("ct").baselineValues((long) 500).build().run();
    testBuilder().sqlQuery(query4).ordered().baselineColumns("ct").baselineValues((long) 900).build().run();
}
